tip.description: The main proactive tip, written in markdown. Include headings, URLs, lists, and code fences as needed.

reasoning.description: 1-2 sentences explaining why this tip was chosen, referencing the specific goal and events that prompted it.

intent_guess.description: What the model thinks the user wants to do next right now, based on goals and events.

urls.description: Relevant URLs to documentation, tools, or resources.

next_actions.description: 2-4 concrete next actions the user can take immediately.

code_snippet.description: A runnable code snippet in a fenced markdown code block, or empty string if not applicable.
